CHAPTER.CAPTION: Psalm of David
CHAPTER.VERS: Save me, O God, by your name, and judge me by your strength.
Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
For strangers have risen up against me. And oppressors seek after my life. They have not kept God in their presence.
Behold, God is my helper: Jehovah is with those who preserve my life.
He will repay my enemies for their evil: consume them in your truth.
I will freely sacrifice to you. O Jehovah, I will praise your name for it is good.
For he has delivered me out of all trouble: and my eye has seen his defeat of my enemies.
